values: 战斗开始后选定狩猎对象。主动使用时，投出狩猎之矛并引爆目标身上的裂伤。
Nazrik marks an enemy as his Prey. When casting this skill, he throws a spear to trigger all Rend stacks on an enemy.

战斗开始4秒后，那非选定当前累计承受伤害最高的敌人作为他的“狩猎对象”，并会优先选取“狩猎对象”作为其技能目标。
主动释放时，那非向狩猎神祈祷，投出一根必定暴击的狩猎之矛，对目标造成600% + 70% ATK的真实伤害，并在短暂延迟后引爆目标身上的裂伤，每层裂伤额外造成35% + 3.5% ATK伤害。

4s into a battle, Nazrik marks the enemy who has taken the most damage as his Prey and prioritizes them as the target for all his skills.
When casting this skill, Nazrik silently prays before hurling a spear with a guaranteed critical hit, dealing 600% + 70% ATK true damage to an enemy. After a short delay, he triggers all Rend stacks on that enemy, dealing 35% + 3.5% ATK extra damage per stack.
狩猎之矛伤害提升至630% + 70% ATK。
Increases the damage of this skill's spear hurl to 630% + 70% ATK.
狩猎之矛伤害提升至660% + 70% ATK。
Increases the damage of this skill's spear hurl to 660% + 70% ATK.
狩猎之矛伤害提升至690% + 70% ATK。
Increases the damage of this skill's spear hurl to 690% + 70% ATK.
狩猎之矛伤害提升至720% + 70% ATK。
Increases the damage of this skill's spear hurl to 720% + 70% ATK.
投矛暴击时对目标叠加裂伤，并在目标释放大招时引爆。
When Nazrik lands a critical hit with a spear throw, he inflicts Rend on the enemy hit. Enemies with Rend take damage whenever they cast their Ultimate.

每当那非通过普通攻击或技能投掷长矛造成暴击时，额外造成目标6.5% + 0.8%初始最大生命值的伤害（最高不超过180% + 20% ATK），并削减等量最大生命值（首领模式下，不会削减最大生命值，但会将上述伤害转为真实伤害），最多削减40%，同时使目标获得5层裂伤，最多叠加30层，该效果不可被驱散。
当带有裂伤的敌人释放终极技能时，每层裂伤使其受到35% + 3.5% ATK的伤害。

Whenever Nazrik lands a critical hit on an enemy with a spear throw from his normal attacks or skills, he deals extra damage equal to 6.5% + 0.8% of the enemy's initial max HP. The extra damage cannot exceed 180% + 20% ATK.
Each hit also reduces the enemy's max HP by the same amount, up to 40%. Against bosses, the max HP reduction does not apply; instead, the extra damage is converted into true damage.
Additionally, each hit inflicts 5 stacks of Rend on the enemy, up to 30 stacks. This effect cannot be dispelled.
When an enemy affected by Rend casts their Ultimate, they take 35% + 3.5% ATK damage for each Rend stack they currently have.
造成最大生命值伤害提升至7% + 0.8%。
Increases the extra damage dealt to 7% + 0.8% of the enemy's max HP.
造成最大生命值伤害提升至7.5% + 0.8%。
Increases the extra damage dealt to 7.5% + 0.8% of the enemy's max HP.
造成最大生命值伤害提升至8% + 0.8%。
Increases the extra damage dealt to 8% + 0.8% of the enemy's max HP.
对累计治疗量的敌人投出长矛，造成伤害和晕眩，并使其治愈降低。
Nazrik hurls a spear at the enemy with the highest total healing done, dealing damage, stunning them, and reducing their Healing.
对累计治疗量最高的敌人投掷长矛，造成300% + 40% ATK伤害并使其晕眩3秒，同时降低其90点治愈，持续15秒。
Nazrik hurls a spear at the enemy with the highest total healing done, dealing 300% + 40% ATK damage, stunning them for 3s, and reducing their Healing by 90 for 15s.
提升自身暴击，叠加裂伤可进一步增加暴击。
Nazrik increases his Crit and gains extra Crit after inflicting a certain number of Rend stacks.
战斗中，自身的暴击提高24点，自身累计对敌方叠加15层裂伤后，额外提升12点暴击。
Nazrik increases his Crit by 24 during battle. After inflicting a total of 15 Rend stacks on enemies, he gains an extra 12 Crit.
战斗中，自身的暴击提高30点，自身累计对敌方叠加15层裂伤后，额外提升15点暴击。
Nazrik increases his Crit by 30 during battle. After inflicting a total of 15 Rend stacks on enemies, he gains an extra 15 Crit.
战斗中，自身的暴击提高36点，自身累计对敌方叠加15层裂伤后，额外提升18点暴击。
Nazrik increases his Crit by 36 during battle. After inflicting a total of 15 Rend stacks on enemies, he gains an extra 18 Crit.
友方角色对狩猎对象造成伤害时也会叠加裂伤。
Allied units have a chance to inflict Rend stacks whenever they deal damage to Nazrik's Prey.
那非的“狩猎对象”抗暴击降低16点，并且当其他友方角色对“狩猎对象”造成暴击时，也会对其叠加1层裂伤，每名友军每秒最多通过此种方式叠加1层。
Nazrik reduces his Prey's Crit Resist by 16. When allied units land a critical hit on his Prey, they inflict 1 stack of Rend. Each ally can apply only 1 Rend stack per second this way.
Reduces the Prey's Crit Resist by 24.
“狩猎对象”身上的裂伤不低于15层时，受愈降低50点，受到伤害增加12%。
When the Prey has at least 15 Rend stacks, reduces their Vitality by 50, and increases their damage taken by 12%.
Reduces the Prey's Crit Resist by 32.
造成暴击时，提升此次伤害的暴击增幅。
Each time Nazrik lands a critical hit, that hit gains increased Crit DMG Boost.
每当那非造成暴击伤害时，自身每1%的暴击率会使本次伤害额外提高0.8点暴击增幅。
Each time Nazrik lands a critical hit on an enemy, the Crit DMG Boost of that hit increases by 0.8 for every 1% of Nazrik's crit rate.
